search_log: listed Amgen (CIK 0000318154) filings via data.sec.gov/submissions (recent + older pages), keeping every form starting '8-K' (8-K and 8-K/A) or '10-' (10-Q, 10-K, amendments): 323 8-K, 2 8-K/A, 98 10-Q, 31 10-K; the two 8-K/As are dated 1995 and 2020 and are not earnings releases

took every 8-K carrying Item 2.02 from 2012-01-26 to 2026-08-04, fetched each filing's index.json, and kept the exhibit that contains both 'Enbrel' and 'Repatha' or 'Prolia': 59 earnings-release exhibits covering the fourth quarter of 2011 through the second quarter of 2026, no quarter missing

parsed each release's HTML table rows; the product table ('$Millions, except percentages' with U.S., ROW and TOTAL columns) was checked for every quarter, and for each fiscal year the four quarters were summed and compared with the full-year table in the fourth-quarter release (all matched exactly for the rows used)

2014Q4: the fourth-quarter 2014 release has no Blincyto line; the Form 10-K for 2014 prints Blincyto 3 for 2014 and dashes for 2013 and 2012; approval letter for BLA 125557 (https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/appletter/2014/125557Orig1s000ltr.pdf) lists amendments through Dec. 2, 2014; 2014Q4 = 3 is recorded as full_year_less_other_reported_quarters with the zero for Q1-Q3 2014 inferred (flagged approximate)

2015Q1 is read from the first-quarter 2015 release; 2015Q2-Q4 appear only inside 'Other' in their own releases and are read from the prior-year columns of the 2016Q2-Q4 releases; 2016Q1 onward from each quarter's own release
the verifier's fourth-quarter rule: full-year Blincyto 2015 = 77 = 15+17+23+22 and 2016 = 115 matched the 2017-02 release
